results.title: Hidden Play
results.overview: In the middle of a strange universe where light and darkness clash, two allies try to escape the war. Unfortunately, their survival depends on the invisible forces that manipulate their destiny.

results.title: Our Father
results.overview: When four strangers waiting for confession discover the priest has been murdered, they realize they're the only suspects and must turn to each other to uncover the killer before guilt consumes them all.

results.title: Screaming, Laughing
results.overview: A couple’s getaway takes a strange and violent turn when a terrifying encounter shatters their idyllic beach house retreat.

results.title: Birds of War
results.overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

results.title: Threshold
results.overview: The mind builds the Dehleej, but the heart crosses it.

results.title: Stardom Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Second Round~
results.overview: Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Second Round~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 8, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It primarily focused on second round matches for the company's annual single-elimination tournament, as well as other featured bouts.

results.title: Mary the Widow
results.overview: An aging widow begrudgingly goes to a speed-dating event at her daughter’s request. Among a string of dud dates, one gentle stranger lingers in her mind. Mary the Widow is a tender look at love, memory, and the echoes of what we’ve lost.

results.title: The Sense of Earth
results.overview: A doctor examines a migrant's body recovered from the sea. During inspection, she finds a plastic bag with a suspicious substance that magically makes her relive the boy's migration journey.

results.title: Kaji
results.overview: A story told with heartfelt honesty seen through the eyes of Kajini, about her Kaji. It is a story of stifled emotions finally finding their flow, and a life that someone, somewhere, deeply yearned to live.

results.title: Service !
results.overview: Théo has failed his A-levels, and his sentence is final: he has to spend the summer slaving away in his parents’ restaurant. To survive this punishment, he decides to hire his gang of mates. A stroke of genius? Not really. Between a self-proclaimed chef who thinks he’s a reality TV star, waiters more interested in flirting than serving, and organisational skills that are virtually non-existent, the family restaurant is set to become the scene of some chaotic fun. It remains to be seen whether they’ll manage to get through the summer without burning the kitchen down.

results.title: Andy Goldsworthy in Conversation with Andrew Graham-Dixon
results.original_title: Andy Goldsworthy in Conversation with Andrew Graham-Dixon
results.overview: Filmed entirely on-site at the National Galleries of Scotland during Goldsworthy's monumental 2025 retrospective, Andy Goldsworthy: 50 Years, this compelling film captures an exclusive, deeply personal dialogue between the world-renowned land artist and the acclaimed art historian, author, and broadcaster.  The documentary offers an unprecedented look behind the scenes of Goldsworthy’s largest and most ambitious indoor exhibition. Surrounded by new installations created specifically for the show, the pair explore the core environmental philosophies, fleeting natural materials, and creative ideas that have defined the artist's extraordinary half-century career.

results.title: The Trace
results.overview: A young man has an exhausting job in the family business. His nightmares merge with reality as he struggles to work for his father.

results.title: Anthôman
results.overview: Gooré and Kalou maintain a deep friendship. The first is a talented drummer, while the second excels in the art of dance. One day, during a hunting trip, Gooré, through an unfortunate combination of circumstances, accidentally takes Kalou's life. Despite the negative result of the Zri, a traditional test supposed to establish the guilt or innocence of an individual and from which Gooré emerges unscathed, the villagers accuse him of having murdered his friend out of jealousy. Determined to clear his honor, Gooré then made a radical decision: he entered the Second World War. According to tradition, his return alive from the front would constitute irrefutable proof of his innocence.

results.title: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 4

results.overview: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 4 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on January 31, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Diversa
results.overview: The arrival of a young French female veterinarian in a small Southern Italian town triggers a long-planned revenge, exposing buried secrets and challenging deeply rooted prejudice.

results.title: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
results.original_title: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
results.overview: Ronni is living a full life as a school nurse and mom, hosting a longtime mahjong game with her best friends Shelley, Carly, and Melissa. But when her daughter leaves for college, everything shifts at once. Her hours get cut. Her ex is pushing to sell the home she loves. And suddenly she's staring down an empty nest wondering what comes next.

results.title: Unholy Valentina
results.overview: Valentina, unlucky in love, develops an allergy to romance. She sneezes at lovers, and they break up. This puts her career, her parents' relationship, and her close friend at risk. Therefore, Valentina urgently needs to find a cure.

results.title: Conversations on a Boat
results.overview: Two women in their sixties meet on a boat in the Oslofjord, where an apparently calm reunion gradually reveals a complex relationship marked by desire, longing, and unresolved love. The film explores time, aging, and the freedom that emerges after midlife.

results.title: Horse on a Stick
results.overview: Sarah and her best friend Dilek have a YouTube channel together, but it's no success. Sarah then discovers “hobbyhorsing” for herself, but Dilek doesn't think much of it.
